The audio asset id 39b42989... is stage's own stable_id of the draft id and matched without intervention; the only post-stage change was the TimingMap row id (a model default uuid4) set to 83fb3f56... in one transaction. The recomputed revision_hash of the draft equals production's 41a30de3..., and the rebuilt reader package's sha256 equals production's 3c86e4a4..., an independent check of every ID it embeds. Draft audio is not served by the release code, so the player was reached on a disposable copy of the replica where the staged draft was published through the release code's own transitions (attach_audiovisual_audio publish -> transition_revision mark-ready and publish, full validate_revision: all checks pass) with a copy-only bootstrap report that was deleted and never committed; the revision, its IDs and its hash are unchanged by publishing. On that copy, a fresh verified non-staff reader per viewport signed in through the sign-in form at 1440x900 and 390x844 (mobile emulation with touch): the reader page's 39 paragraphs were compared with export_audiovisual_source --revision of the staged draft; the listen page's media grant and every MP3 response were recorded; the native play control was clicked and currentTime measured 4 s later; currentTime was set to 451 s (as the native scrubber does) and measured 3 s later; then the player's Switch to Read button and the sheet's Switch to Read button were pressed, and the landing reader URL's anchor was compared with the paragraph timing.json maps to 451000 ms (timing.json names live anchors; matched to the staged anchor by paragraph ordinal) and checked to be in the viewport. Horizontal overflow was checked on the reader, the player, the open switch sheet and the landing reader; page errors and console errors were collected throughout. Publish check: `attach_audiovisual_audio publish bicharak --browser-report docs/evidence/publication-browser-20261128-bicharak-audio.json` was run on a fresh restore of the exact replica (draft 67ad5cee still a draft) and accepted this report.
